_about: THEY MEND ON THE MARCH (ANIMATION, ask line 314): who on the map's walking party works at his wounds or his gear as he walks, and when. engine/bohemia_march_acts.js reads every number here (a modder's file: change one, reload). The pictures are slices/rig_march (tools/bohemia_animation_they_mend_on_the_march.py); the acts' own lengths are their timelines there, whole bars at 120.

men_at_once.unit: men of the walking party at work at the same moment
men_at_once.source: records/BOHEMIA_EVERYTHING_HE_ASKED_10_24_26.md (ask line 314), Paolo 11/2: 'I like these animations, let's make this happen... it has to look good'; the brief: 'one or two men at a time across the party, never everyone at once'

start_chance.unit: the chance, on each new bar, that a man who needs it and is free starts one (so it is not every bar on the dot)

rest_bars_min.unit: bars a man rests before he works again (and after an act cut short by a stop or a turn away)
rest_bars_min.source: the brief: 'a pause of several bars before the same man does it again'; draft:true

rest_bars_max.unit: the longest rest, in bars (each rest is drawn between the two)

first_bars.unit: bars of walking before anybody starts (nothing happens in the first second, the second votes)
first_bars.source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_SECOND_VOTES_9_24_26.md: NOTHING IS FORCED AND NOTHING HAPPENS IN THE FIRST SECOND

heal_below.unit: the share of his hitpoints under which a man is healing on the march (the map heals 1 an hour, engine/bohemia_condition.js)

bandage_below.unit: under this share of his hitpoints he binds a wound (the bandage); over it, an ache, the pills
bandage_below.source: the brief: 'a man low on HP bandages or takes pills'; draft:true, ANIMATION's split

mend_min_points.unit: armour points a piece must be down before he works on it; and only while the company has TAPE (the march mends with tape: no tape, nothing mended, nobody tapes)
mend_min_points.source: engine/bohemia_condition.js elapse (3 points a piece an hour, one tape for 15)

keys_per_beat.unit: drawn keys a beat (twelve a bar), the body's grid
keys_per_beat.source: the 120 BPM law; CLAUDE.md AN ENVELOPE RAMPS SLOWER THAN THE GRID

helmet_hard_classes.unit: the head pieces (CHARACTER's wear classes, records/target/bb/armour_looks.json) that have a dent to knock out; a rag hood, a bandana, a straw hat, a dust or gas mask or a chain hood is mended with no act
helmet_hard_classes.source: the brief: 'a man with a dented helmet does 4'; draft:true
